messages:
Maya C: Quick heads-up 8am PT9 AcmeHealth returned the vendor questionnaire but left the DPA unsigned and no SOC2 attestation attached.

Rahul P: I pulled their submission. Missing items: signed DPA, SOC2 AOC or report (last 12 months), and explicit KMS provider for customer-managed keys.

Marta (CS): I'll ask them to attach the signed DPA and SOC2 evidence. Any special DPA language Legal needs? @Rahul P

Rahul P: Use Redwood DPA v3 as default. If they propose SLA or term changes, route redlines to Legal. If they only have SOC2 Type 1, flag for a SecOps follow-up.

Ben (CS): FYI renewal check in 6 weeks. Leave a renewal risk note in Gainsight if evidence stays outstanding. Don't let AM be surprised.

Marta (CS): Draft message I'm about to send:

> Hi team, thanks for the completed questionnaire. Could you please attach the signed Redwood DPA (v3) and either a SOC2 AOC or SOC2 report covering the most recent 12 months? Also confirm the KMS/HSM provider for customer-managed keys (e.g., AWS KMS, GCP KMS, vendor HSM). If any docs are sensitive we can provide an SFTP upload link.

Maya C: Also ask for their data flow diagram and a short retention policy excerpt (embeddings, logs) SRE needs that for residency/SOC2 scoping.

Rahul P: Add this checklist in the thread:
- Signed DPA (Redwood DPA v3)
- SOC2 AOC or SOC2 report (last 12 months)
- Named KMS/HSM vendor + key lifecycle notes
- Data flow diagram showing PII handling
- Retention policy excerpt for embeddings/logs

SecOpsBot: Reminder: "AcmeHealth" vendor intake has 3 outstanding evidence items. Assigned: Marta (CS). Deadline: 2025-03-08.

Marta (CS): Message sent. I'll upload attachments to /shared/customer-evidence/AcmeHealth when they come in.

Ben (CS): If they push on DPA SLA changes, escalate with a short risk summary. I can draft the summary for Legal.

Maya C: Customer replied they attached a SOC2 Type 2 for 2023 and confirmed AWS KMS for keys. DPA still unsigned; they requested changing the SLA window to 48 hours.

Rahul P: SOC2 Type 2 is acceptable. SLA change needs Legal approval. Looping Legal for an expedited review.

Ben (CS): Marked renewal risk in Gainsight as "evidence pending - legal review" and pinged AM.

SecOpsBot: Evidence upload detected: /shared/customer-evidence/AcmeHealth/soc2_2023_type2.pdf

Maya C: Great. Leave this open until Legal confirms SLA language. If no reply in 3 business days, escalate to the CS lead. :thumbsup:
